description: Extract the text from a PDF file at a URL and return it as markdown, page by page. Use it to read a PDF, parse a form, report, paper, invoice, or document, or convert a PDF to text. Works on PDFs with a text layer (scanned image-only PDFs return little or no text; no OCR). Price: $0.005 per successful call; failed calls are free. Free to try: a few calls a day without a key.

api_key.description: Your Unstuck API key, if this connection has none. Leave empty to try free tools or to get a key and payment link.

url.description: The http(s) URL of the PDF file.

name: pdf_to_text

charged_usd.description: Amount charged for this call, USD.

likely_scanned.description: True if the PDF looks image-only (little extractable text).

markdown.description: Text as markdown, one "## Page N" section per page.

title.description: Title from the PDF metadata, if any.

truncated.description: True if the text was cut at the size limit.

title: Extract Text from a PDF
